caseTitle.en: The period was only a few days late

condition.zh: 急性腹痛 · 子宮外孕

title.en: A gynaecology night in the ER

tagline.zh: 會懷孕的人肚子痛，先驗孕
tagline.en: Abdominal pain in anyone who could be pregnant: test first

desc.zh: 急診的婦科會診。肚子痛、出血、昏倒。探頭在口袋，手術室在樓上。
desc.en: The gynaecology consult in the ER. Pain, bleeding, fainting. Probe in your pocket, theatre upstairs.

desc.zh: 第一個看到病人的人。生命徵象、驗孕棒、一句單獨的問話。
desc.en: The first person to see every patient. Vital signs, a pregnancy test, and one question asked in private.

about.zh: 說話很輕，下刀很快。口頭禪：「肚子痛的女生，先驗孕。」
about.en: Speaks softly, operates fast. Catchphrase: 'Abdominal pain in a woman: test for pregnancy first.'

about.zh: 三秒鐘看出誰在硬撐。抽屜裡有驗孕棒，也有巧克力。
about.en: Spots who is putting a brave face on in three seconds. Her drawer holds pregnancy tests and chocolate.

about.zh: 會計，月結這週天天加班。月經晚了幾天，以為是太累。今晚痛到右肩。
about.en: An accountant in month-end week. Period a few days late; she put it down to overwork. Tonight the pain reached her right shoulder.

about.zh: 不知道她可能懷孕。她也不知道。一直問能不能幫忙拿什麼。
about.en: Didn't know she might be pregnant. Neither did she. Keeps asking if he can fetch anything.

about.zh: 國三，籃球校隊。月經一來就十天，今天在體育課昏倒。
about.en: Year nine, school basketball team. Her periods last ten days; today she fainted in PE.

about.zh: 自己的月經也一直很多，以為是遺傳的體質，「女生就是這樣」。
about.en: Her own periods were always heavy too; she thought it ran in the family: 'that's just how it is for girls'.

about.zh: 只在電話裡。聽到「子宮外孕、血壓掉」就直接說：「房間開好了。」
about.en: Only on the phone. Hear 'ectopic, pressure falling' and he just says: 'Theatre's open.'

about.zh: 危急值一出來就打電話，要你複誦一次才掛。
about.en: Rings the moment a critical value appears and won't hang up until you read it back.

plain.zh: 胚胎著床在子宮以外，大多在輸卵管。長大到撐破時會大出血，是年輕女性腹痛最危險的原因之一。
plain.en: A pregnancy implanted outside the womb, usually in a fallopian tube. When it grows enough to rupture it bleeds heavily; one of the most dangerous causes of pain in young women.

plain.zh: 驗尿或驗血中的 hCG。會懷孕年紀的女性腹痛或出血，不管她怎麼說，都先驗。
plain.en: Detects hCG in urine or blood. Any woman of childbearing age with pain or bleeding is tested, whatever she says.

plain.zh: 肚子裡的血刺激橫膈，痛覺被「轉送」到肩膀。肚子痛加肩膀痛，要想到腹腔內出血。
plain.en: Blood in the abdomen irritates the diaphragm and the pain is 'referred' to the shoulder. Belly pain plus shoulder pain means think of internal bleeding.

plain.zh: 血流到肚子裡面，外面看不到。量多時血壓會掉、會昏倒。
plain.en: Blood inside the abdomen, invisible from outside. In large amounts the pressure falls and the patient faints.

plain.zh: 醫師在病床旁自己做的快速超音波，回答一兩個關鍵問題：子宮裡有沒有胚胎？肚子裡有沒有血？
plain.en: A quick scan done by the doctor at the bedside to answer one or two key questions: is there a pregnancy in the womb? Is there blood in the abdomen?

plain.zh: 肝臟和右腎之間的空隙，躺著時腹腔的血會流到這裡。這裡看到液體，代表出血量不少。
plain.en: The space between the liver and right kidney where blood collects when lying down. Fluid here means a sizeable bleed.

plain.zh: 驗孕陽性但超音波還看不到胚胎在哪裡。病人穩定時，追蹤抽血與超音波；不穩定就是急症。
plain.en: A positive test but no pregnancy visible on scan yet. If she is stable, follow with blood tests and scans; if not, it is an emergency.

plain.zh: 把有子宮外孕的那條輸卵管切掉，止血最確實。另一側輸卵管健康時，之後仍有機會自然懷孕。
plain.en: Removing the tube containing the ectopic; the surest way to stop the bleeding. With a healthy tube on the other side, natural pregnancy remains possible.

plain.zh: 問從初經開始月經多不多、會不會流鼻血、刷牙流血、拔牙後血流不止、家人有沒有一樣。用來篩檢凝血疾病。
plain.en: Asking about heavy periods since the first one, nosebleeds, bleeding gums, prolonged bleeding after dental extraction, and family members alike. It screens for clotting disorders.

plain.zh: 最常見的遺傳性凝血疾病，常以「月經很多」表現。很多媽媽和女兒都以為那只是體質。
plain.en: The commonest inherited bleeding disorder, often showing up as heavy periods. Many mothers and daughters assume it is just how they are.

plain.zh: 檢驗結果嚴重到必須立刻通知醫師的數值。接電話的人要複誦、記錄、馬上處理。
plain.en: A result so abnormal the doctor must be told immediately. Whoever takes the call reads it back, records it and acts.

plain.zh: 一種非荷爾蒙的止血藥，減少月經出血量。劑量與禁忌依醫囑。
plain.en: A non-hormonal medicine that reduces menstrual bleeding. Dose and contraindications per protocol.

text.zh: 兩個問題：子宮裡有沒有？肚子裡有沒有血？回答完就推走，不要在床邊看風景。
text.en: Two questions: is it in the womb, and is there blood in the abdomen? Answer them and wheel it away; no sightseeing.

text.zh: 全急診最便宜、最常救命的檢查。檢傷站的抽屜裡永遠有一盒。
text.en: The cheapest and most often life-saving test in the ER. There's always a box in the triage drawer.

text.zh: 右側輸卵管壺腹部腫脹破裂。標籤：姓名、病歷號、部位、時間，送病理確認。
text.en: Right tube, swollen and ruptured at the ampulla. Labelled with name, record number, site and time, sent to pathology to confirm.

text.zh: 籃球比賽行程旁邊畫著小紅點，一個月有十個。媽媽說她自己的也是這樣。
text.en: Little red dots beside the basketball fixtures, ten a month. Her mother says hers were the same.

name.en: Test everyone who could be pregnant

text.zh: 病史會騙人：月經「才晚幾天」、「不可能」、「有避孕」、家長說「她沒有」。子宮外孕在破裂之前常常只是輕微腹痛和少量出血。所以會懷孕年紀的女性，只要腹痛、出血、昏倒，或要照 X 光、開藥、手術，就先驗孕，而且要私下問。
text.en: Histories mislead: 'only a few days late', 'impossible', 'we use contraception', a parent saying 'she doesn't'. Before it ruptures, an ectopic often shows only mild pain and a little bleeding. So any woman of childbearing age with pain, bleeding or fainting, or before X-rays, drugs or surgery, gets a pregnancy test, and is asked in private.

text.zh: 驗孕陽性但子宮裡看不到胚胎：可能太早、可能流產、也可能是子宮外孕。病人穩定、沒有積血，可以追蹤抽血與超音波；有腹痛、肩尖痛、腹腔積液或血壓不穩，就當子宮外孕處理：兩條靜脈、配血、通知主治與麻醉，直到證明不是。
text.en: Positive test, nothing in the womb: too early, a miscarriage, or an ectopic. If she is stable with no free fluid, follow with bloods and scans; with pain, shoulder-tip pain, free fluid or unstable pressure, treat it as ectopic until proven otherwise: two lines, crossmatch, call the attending and anaesthesia.

name.zh: 從初經就很多，想到凝血
name.en: Heavy since the first period: think clotting

text.zh: 青少女月經過多，不是只想到荷爾蒙。從初經就很多、流鼻血、刷牙流血、家人也一樣，要篩檢凝血疾病，類血友病最常見。凝血相關檢查盡量在輸血或開始荷爾蒙之前抽，結果才準。
text.en: Heavy periods in a teenager are not only about hormones. Heavy from the first period, nosebleeds, bleeding gums, relatives the same: screen for a bleeding disorder, von Willebrand disease being commonest. Draw clotting tests before transfusion or hormones where possible, so the results mean something.

lines.zh: 今晚急診的婦科會診是你。第一句話記好：肚子痛的女生，先驗孕。
lines.en: You're the gynae consult in the ER tonight. Remember the first rule: abdominal pain in a woman, test for pregnancy first.

lines.zh: 就算她說不可能？
lines.en: Even if she says it's impossible?

lines.zh: 尤其是她說不可能。
lines.en: Especially if she says it's impossible.

lines.zh: 床邊超音波充好電了，探頭兩支都在。驗孕棒在我抽屜，巧克力不准拿。
lines.en: The point-of-care ultrasound is charged, both probes there. Pregnancy tests are in my drawer. The chocolate is off limits.

q.zh: 點一下床邊超音波，確認腹部探頭在
q.en: Tap the bedside ultrasound and check the abdominal probe is there

note.zh: 宜庭：驗孕陽性，子宮是空的

guide.en: Triage: vital signs and a test

lines.zh: 我只是肚子痛，月經晚了幾天而已，應該是加班太累。
lines.en: It's just a tummy ache. My period's only a few days late; I'm overworked.

lines.zh: 這是每個女生都要做的：先驗孕。妳男朋友先在外面等一下好嗎？
lines.en: Everyone gets this: a pregnancy test first. Could your boyfriend wait outside for a moment?

lines.zh: 血壓偏低、心跳偏快。驗孕棒兩條線。
lines.en: Blood pressure on the low side, pulse fast. Two lines on the test.

lines.zh: ……兩條線？痛了兩天，右下腹。剛才連右肩也痛，很奇怪。
lines.en: ...two lines? It's hurt for two days, lower right. Just now my right shoulder started hurting too. Weird.

lines.zh: 不奇怪。肚子痛加肩尖痛，要想到肚子裡面在出血。
lines.en: Not weird. Belly pain plus shoulder-tip pain makes me think of bleeding inside.

lines.zh: 驗孕陽性、下腹痛、肩膀痛。你的計畫？
lines.en: Positive test, lower abdominal pain, shoulder pain. Your plan?

q.zh: 驗孕陽性、腹痛加肩尖痛，下一步？
q.en: Positive test, pain and shoulder-tip pain: next?

options.zh: 當子宮外孕處理：靜脈、配血、超音波
options.en: Treat as ectopic: lines, crossmatch, scan

why.zh: 對。直到證明不是，都當子宮外孕：兩條靜脈、抽血配血、床邊超音波、通知主治與麻醉。
why.en: Right. Ectopic until proven otherwise: two lines, bloods and crossmatch, bedside scan, tell the attending and anaesthesia.

options.zh: 可能太早看不到，兩天後再抽血
options.en: Probably too early; repeat bloods in two days

why.zh: 這是「位置不明的懷孕」給穩定、不痛、沒有積血的人的路徑。她有肩尖痛、心跳快，不是這一群。
why.en: The pregnancy of unknown location pathway is for women who are stable, pain-free and without free fluid. Shoulder-tip pain and a fast pulse put her outside it.

why.zh: 止痛可以給，但不能取代找出血。
why.en: Pain relief, yes, but not instead of looking for the bleed.

lines.zh: 經腹先看。子宮裡有沒有？旁邊有沒有東西？後面有沒有黑黑的液體？
lines.en: Transabdominal first. Anything in the uterus? Anything beside it? Dark fluid behind it?

post.zh: 子宮內膜厚，裡面沒有妊娠囊。右側附件一團混濁的腫塊，子宮後方有積液。
post.en: Thick lining, no gestational sac in the uterus. A murky mass by the right ovary; fluid behind the uterus.

note.zh: 莫里森氏囊有血，直接上手術室
note.en: Blood in Morison's pouch: straight to theatre

lines.zh: 宜庭在急診門口簽離院單的時候昏倒了！
lines.en: Yi-ting collapsed at the exit while signing her discharge form!

lines.zh: 推回來！兩條大靜脈、配血，我叫主治。……是我判斷錯了。
lines.en: Bring her back! Two wide lines, crossmatch, I'll call the attending. ...that was my wrong call.

lines.zh: 她臉好白，叫她都不太回答！
lines.en: She's so pale, she's barely answering!

lines.zh: 血壓往下掉，心跳很快，手腳冰冷。
lines.en: Blood pressure dropping, heart racing, cold hands and feet.

options.zh: 呼叫、兩條大靜脈、輸液輸血、通知手術室
options.en: Call, two wide lines, fluids and blood, alert theatre

why.zh: 對。子宮外孕破裂、腹腔內出血。急救的同時，真正的止血在手術室。
why.en: Right. A ruptured ectopic with haemoperitoneum. Resuscitate while you move; the real haemostasis happens in theatre.

options.zh: 再做一次完整的陰道超音波確認
options.en: A full transvaginal scan to be sure

why.zh: 診斷已經夠了。休克的病人不等完整的檢查。
why.en: You have enough for the diagnosis. A shocked patient does not wait for a complete scan.

why.zh: 急性出血時，血紅素還來不及下降。看病人，不是看數字。
why.en: In acute bleeding the haemoglobin hasn't fallen yet. Treat the patient, not the number.

guide.en: Look at the right upper abdomen

lines.zh: 探頭移到右上腹。為什麼看那裡？
lines.en: Move the probe to the right upper quadrant. Why there?

question.zh: 懷疑腹腔內出血，為什麼要看莫里森氏囊？看到什麼代表什麼？
question.en: Suspected haemoperitoneum: why look at Morison's pouch, and what does a finding there mean?

answer.zh: 病人躺著時，腹腔的血會往肝臟與右腎之間流。骨盆有液體可能是少量；連莫里森氏囊都有液體，代表出血量大，要馬上手術。
answer.en: Lying down, blood in the abdomen tracks to the gap between the liver and the right kidney. Pelvic fluid may be a small amount; fluid reaching Morison's pouch means a large bleed and immediate surgery.

post.zh: 肝腎之間一條黑色的液體帶。
post.en: A dark band of fluid between liver and kidney.

lines.zh: 子宮外孕破裂、腹腔內出血、血壓掉。已經兩條靜脈，血在配。
lines.en: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy, haemoperitoneum, pressure falling. Two lines in, blood being crossmatched.

lines.zh: 房間開好了，直接推上來。血一到就給。
lines.en: Theatre's open. Bring her straight up. Blood goes in as soon as it arrives.

note.zh: 右側輸卵管切除，止血完成

lines.zh: 她會不會……她還能生小孩嗎？
lines.en: Will she... can she still have children?

lines.zh: 先救她。如果要切掉一邊的輸卵管，另一邊健康的話，之後還是有機會。
lines.en: First we save her. If one tube has to come out and the other is healthy, she still has a chance later.

lines.zh: 肚子裡都是血。先吸，看到右邊輸卵管，夾住它下面的系膜。
lines.en: The belly is full of blood. Suction first, find the right tube, clamp the mesosalpinx beneath it.

post.zh: 右側輸卵管壺腹部破了一個洞。輸卵管切除。左側輸卵管看起來很健康。
post.en: A hole in the ampulla of the right tube. Salpingectomy. The left tube looks perfectly healthy.

post.zh: 左邊很漂亮。等一下第一句就告訴他們這個。
post.en: The left side is lovely. Tell them that first.

lines.zh: 我可以做什麼？
lines.en: What can I do?

lines.zh: 幫她拿手機充電、打給她家人。還有，她醒來的時候在旁邊。
lines.en: Charge her phone, call her family. And be there when she wakes up.

lines.zh: 阿蓮從抽屜拿了一塊巧克力給他。
lines.en: A-lien takes a chocolate from her drawer and hands it to him.

note.en: Hsiao-man: heavy since the very first period

sub.zh: 15 歲女孩，月經大量出血、昏倒

lines.zh: 十五歲，月經第八天還很多，體育課昏倒，臉色很白。媽媽陪著。
lines.en: Fifteen, day eight of a heavy period, fainted in PE, very pale. Her mother's with her.

lines.zh: 女生就是這樣，我年輕的時候也一樣多。
lines.en: That's just girls. Mine were just as heavy at her age.

lines.zh: 那我們一起回想：小曼會不會常流鼻血？刷牙流血？拔牙後血流很久？
lines.en: Let's think back together: does Hsiao-man get nosebleeds? Bleeding gums? Bleeding for ages after a tooth came out?

lines.zh: ……都會。我以為大家都這樣。
lines.en: ...all of those. I thought everyone did.

post.zh: 從初經就很多，加上這些出血病史，要檢查凝血，例如類血友病。
post.en: Heavy since the first period, plus that bleeding history: we test her clotting, for example for von Willebrand disease.

lines.zh: 她才十五歲，驗孕就不用了吧。她沒有男朋友。
lines.en: She's only fifteen. No need for a pregnancy test, surely. She doesn't have a boyfriend.

lines.zh: 你怎麼做？
lines.en: What do you do?

q.zh: 15 歲大量出血，媽媽說不用驗孕？
q.en: Fifteen, heavy bleeding, mother says no pregnancy test?

options.zh: 說明人人都驗，私下問並驗
options.en: Everyone is tested; ask and test privately

why.zh: 對。「每個女生都驗」，不是懷疑誰。請媽媽先出去一下，私下問小曼，再驗。
why.en: Right. 'Every girl is tested' is not suspicion. Ask Mum to step out, ask Hsiao-man privately, then test.

options.en: Mother says no, so skip it

why.zh: 家長不一定知道，青少女也不一定敢說。之後要輸血、用藥，都需要這個結果。
why.en: Parents don't always know, and teenagers don't always say. Transfusion and medicines both need this result.

options.zh: 當著媽媽問她有沒有性行為
options.en: Ask her about sex in front of Mum

why.zh: 她只能回答「沒有」。這種問題要私下問。
why.en: She can only say 'no'. That question is asked in private.

post.zh: 驗孕陰性。小曼私下說：「謝謝你們讓我媽出去。我真的沒有，只是不想在她面前講。」
post.en: Test negative. Hsiao-man, in private: 'Thanks for sending Mum out. I really haven't; I just didn't want to talk about it in front of her.'

lines.zh: 血可能要輸。凝血的檢查什麼時候抽？
lines.en: She may need blood. When do you draw the clotting tests?

lines.zh: 輸血和用荷爾蒙之前先抽，不然結果會被蓋掉。
lines.en: Before any transfusion or hormones, or the results will be masked.

lines.zh: 危急值通知：小曼的血紅素非常低。請複誦。
lines.en: Critical value: Hsiao-man's haemoglobin is very low. Please read it back.

lines.zh: 小曼，血紅素危急值，已複誦，我是婦科住院醫師，現在處理。
lines.en: Hsiao-man, critical haemoglobin, read back; gynae resident here, acting now.

lines.zh: 小曼的血太少了，要輸血。凝血檢查已經先抽了。止血先用傳明酸，依醫囑。
lines.en: Hsiao-man's blood count is too low; she needs a transfusion. The clotting tests are already drawn. For the bleeding, tranexamic acid first, per protocol.

lines.zh: 所以……不是體質？我是不是也……
lines.en: So... it's not just how we are? Do I have it too...?

lines.zh: 有可能是遺傳的凝血問題。血液科門診會一起幫妳們兩個看。
lines.en: It may be an inherited clotting problem. The haematology clinic can see both of you.

guide.en: Dr Chung sends the orders back

lines.zh: 輸血同意書和止血藥都開了，驗孕呢？
lines.en: Transfusion consent and tranexamic acid ordered. And the pregnancy test?

lines.zh: ……沒驗。我現在私下問她，馬上驗。
lines.en: ...not done. I'll ask her privately and test her now.

lines.zh: 尤其是她媽媽說不可能的時候。
lines.en: Especially when her mother says it's impossible.

lines.zh: 今晚兩個「不可能」：宜庭說不可能懷孕，小曼媽媽說不可能是病。
lines.en: Two 'impossibles' tonight: Yi-ting said she couldn't be pregnant; Hsiao-man's mother said it couldn't be an illness.

lines.zh: 兩個都錯了，可是兩個都不是她們的錯。
lines.en: Both were wrong, and neither was their fault.

lines.zh: 所以我們驗、我們問。肩膀痛你沒有放過，那一下就決定了今晚。
lines.en: Which is why we test and we ask. You didn't let the shoulder pain go; that decided the night.

lines.zh: 宜庭在恢復室醒了，第一句問左邊的輸卵管。小曼在輸血，在看籃球比賽重播。
lines.en: Yi-ting woke in recovery and asked about her left tube first. Hsiao-man is being transfused and watching a basketball replay.

lines.zh: 值班未完。阿蓮抽屜裡的巧克力少了兩塊，驗孕棒少了三支。
lines.en: The night goes on. Two chocolates gone from A-lien's drawer, and three pregnancy tests.

sub.zh: 尤其是她說不可能的時候
sub.en: Especially when she says it's impossible
